comparison_definition.covered: Retail Plus can execute and evaluate the central ABCD user outcome with current data, tools, and policy.
comparison_definition.partial: Retail Plus has an adjacent capability, but at least one central ABCD state, rule, action, or outcome is absent.
comparison_definition.missing: Retail Plus cannot execute and objectively evaluate the central ABCD user outcome.
comparison_definition.important_note: Conversation wording alone does not count as coverage; the outcome must be backed by executable tools and evaluable state or communication requirements.

summary.note: The accompanying report narrows these 28 technically relevant candidates to a smaller first implementation batch.
